smell_validity.evidence: Router absorbs thirteen members spanning five foreign responsibilities (correlation metadata, client address, path and query parsing, response synthesis), hollowing six owner modules into forwarders and forcing pub(crate) breaches. Growth magnetism and misplaced-ownership cost are unmistakable without the label; hollowed donors and visibility erosions draw the boundary from healthy design.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Donor modules now mislead (response.rs no longer builds responses), unrelated parsing and synthesis changes collide with routing in one impl, and the passed-everywhere Router invites every new convenience member. Repair restores six ownership boundaries and reverts crate-wide pub(crate) breaches: a lasting trap, but within one crate's layering rather than an architecture-wide shift.

development_plausibility.evidence: All moved bodies are verbatim working framework code with original doc comments, a realistic coordinator rationalization, compiler-driven import churn (tests regain Uuid/HeaderMap imports), and pragmatic pub(crate) widenings exactly where a mover would need them. Members interleave with original logic as accretion, with no task-shaped scaffolding.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt inventories all sixteen members and hollowed donors, names destination modules, pins byte-for-byte behavior (Allow, Location, X-Request-ID, request-id panic, 214 tests), and blocks near-misses: no shims through Router, no test weakening, criterion quiet crate-wide. It prevents incomplete cleanup and wrong direction while leaving many sound designs open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Genuinely different purposes are involved (metadata access, parsing, response synthesis), but most locations succumb to one mechanical inversion. Two stages differ: forwarder-backed members swap bodies verbatim, while donor-less synthesis members (redirect base, non-match, 404) need designed placement/folding decisions.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt itself names the sixteen members, the six donor files, every widening category, behaviors and the structure criterion. Only router-internal call sites (trace and dispatch helper calls) are unlisted, and one direct-caller inspection or compiler pass finds them; no cross-component reasoning is needed.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rules interact: relocation choices set the associated-function count, and moving only the six donor-backed members leaves Router at exactly ten functions, still flagged. Concurrently, visibility reverts depend on the router ceasing wrapper construction, and 404/405 synthesis must move without breaking X-Request-ID stamping used by every response path.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule, relocate each absorbed member verbatim to its prompt-named owning module (inverting forwarders, placing donor-less synthesis helpers in response.rs), rewire callers, and revert widenings, repairs effectively all members, donors and widenings with no per-location behavioral decision.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A body-altering wrong edit (dropped X-Request-ID, wrong redirect status, lost Allow appending, changed panic message) compiles but yields an ordinary, directly comparable wrong result that the described 214-test suite (106 doc tests, should_panic unit test) exercises on plain requests; no special-state escape is established.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
